workspacePicker.title: Choose a workspace
workspacePicker.body: Select a workspace linked to your account.
workspacePicker.failed: Could not open this workspace. Try again.

signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.lead: Sign in to your church’s ChuFlow workspace.
signIn.workspaceHint: Churches set up by the ChuFlow team enter the handle from their welcome message. Leave it empty for Winners Chapel International.
signIn.workspaceUnavailable: That workspace handle isn’t valid. Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.

recovery.requestHint: Enter your sign-in email to request a reset link.
recovery.resetHint: Copy the reset link from your email and paste it here to finish in ChuFlow.
recovery.doneHint: Sign in with your new password.
recovery.sent: If there’s an account for this email, check your inbox for a reset link.
recovery.invalidLink: Paste the full ChuFlow reset link from your email.
recovery.expiredLink: This link is invalid or expired. Request a new one.
recovery.sendFailed: Couldn’t request a reset email. Try again.
recovery.resetFailed: Couldn’t reset your password. Try again.
recovery.workspaceHint: Only for churches set up by the ChuFlow team. Leave it empty for Winners Chapel International.

firstPassword.title: Choose your own password
firstPassword.lead: {workspace} was set up with a temporary password. Replace it with one only you know before you continue.
firstPassword.same: Choose a password different from the temporary one.
firstPassword.missingCurrent: Enter the temporary password you signed in with.
firstPassword.failed: Couldn’t change your password. Try again.
